title: Ruhang
extract:
Ruhang is one of the two type of Link crafting component used to create Zaws in Cetus, and focuses on increasing the Zaw's damage in exchange for Attack Speed.
The initial Ruhang blueprint can be first acquired after reaching the Rank of Neutral with the Ostron and buying it from Hok for  1000. Other versions of the Ruhang are available from Hok after reaching higher ranks and for more  Standing.
